scope.full_M_note: Full-M means 31668 old rows only for derivative statistics; output errors use separately reported center128 and original random32 rows.
scope.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of case-level squared-error/energy ratios; not pooled SSE and not independent replications across blocks/tokens.

ideal_projection_cost.exclusions: Ideal projection MAC only; excludes Q1/Q2, layout, routing, fetching, matrix creation, storage and error propagation. Increment controls recompute old/current selected W1 instead of free cached old hidden.

limitations: All data come from two exposed image/seed clusters; no new source/seed quality evidence.
Saved-data representations are not returned to the network; no candidate video or packed partial Q2/FFN exists.
Source-fixed parameters are calibrated only on the other source; posthoc energy ranking is label-informed and not a net-error-optimal oracle.
Microbenchmark uses repeated saved rows at native full-M shape, not natural full-M tensors or end-to-end generation.
No general exclusion of affine bases, nonlinear residuals, offline fixed slopes or fused observers follows from these local errors.
